widgets.text: Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ) – Renton Technologies
Fast answers for your IT rental needs.

Where is Renton Technologies LLP located in Electronic City, and how do I find the office? Renton Technologies LLP is situated on the First Floor of the Lava Kusha Building (No. 6/2) in Beratena Agrahara, Electronic City, Bengaluru, Karnataka 560100 . Our office is conveniently located along Hosur Road , directly opposite the local Metro Station and right next to the Damro Furniture, Nexa and MG Car Showrooms . For hassle-free navigation and real-time transit routes, you can locate our precise pin drop via the official Google Maps Profile for Renton Technologies LLP What IT equipment can I rent from Renton Technologies in Bangalore? Renton Technologies offers a comprehensive range of IT hardware for rent, including high-performance laptops, professional desktop PCs, enterprise-grade servers, workstations, and multi-function printers/scanners . We cater to corporate offices, startups, and events across Bangalore and India with scalable rental solutions. Do you provide laptop rentals for individuals or only for businesses? We primarily specialize in B2B corporate laptop rental in Bangalore and bulk requirements for offices, training programs, and events. However, we do offer flexible plans for long-term individual professional requirements. Contact our team at +91 805028-1515 to discuss your specific needs. What happens if a rented laptop or printer stops working? We pride ourselves on reliability. Renton Technologies provides rapid replacement and on-site technical support in Bangalore. If a device malfunctions, our engineers will troubleshoot it or provide a replacement within 72 hours to ensure zero downtime for your business. Is maintenance included in the monthly rental cost? Absolutely. All our rental plans include 1 year free maintenance and servicing . This allows you to acquire enterprise-grade tech without the burden of ownership or hidden repair costs.

Can I customize the configuration of the rented laptops or servers? Yes. We understand that every business has unique needs. Whether you need increased RAM for data science , high-end GPUs for rendering , or specific storage capacities for servers , we provide custom-configured hardware to match your technical workflow. Are the rental laptops and desktops pre-loaded with software? Our devices come with a clean OS installation. Upon request, we can pre-configure machines with specific software stacks or security protocols to ensure your team is “ready-to-work” the moment the hardware arrives. Where is Renton Technologies located, and which areas do you serve? Our head office is located in Electronic City, Bangalore (Beratena Agrahara) . While we are the leading provider for the Bangalore tech hub, we also support corporate IT requirements across India with seamless delivery and setup services like desktop rental in Bangalore. Why should I choose renting over buying IT hardware for my startup? Renting from Renton Technologies helps you conserve capital and improve cash flow . Instead of a massive upfront investment in depreciating assets, you get access to the latest technology with tax-deductible monthly expenses and the flexibility to scale your fleet as your team grows.
